label: Within the outer supposition that no NECESSARY_BEING_4 is possible, the source assumes C necessary…
paraphrase: Within the outer supposition that no Necessary Being is possible, the source assumes C necessary and rejects that inner assumption: included contingent members would be necessary, or an empty roster would make absence of contingent things necessary, with the retained possible-caused-thing content yielding a contradiction to the outer supposition. It then calls possible nonnecessary C contingent and applies W’s individual causability coverage to that SAME C. The outer supposition persists; historical-to-modal membership, the earlier positive-caused content and actual-concrete causal guards are not independently supplied.
